The boundary lines are \(y = 2x\) through O, \(x = 3\) through C, and \(4x + 3y = 60\) through A and B.

\(y \ge 2x\) is the side of \(y = 2x\) towards the y-axis, \(x \ge 3\) is to the right of \(x = 3\), and \(4x + 3y \le 60\) is the side of AB towards O.

Together they give the triangle D(3, 6), E(6, 12), F(3, 16), which is region \(S_2\).
